title: Prompt calibration: what the record misses
description: Four of your voice prompts, refined by Haiku and Sonnet: the asks and questions no task holds yet.

add.text: Four of your voice prompts from the 11-06 cloud session were checked against the 24 tasks on the voice app's record. **Sonnet did it better and cheaper than Haiku** (about $0.03 a prompt). Below is what no task holds yet. Nothing here has been filed: each card is a suggestion. Full results: [calibration/results.md](/framework/ai/sessions/2026/11/06/spawned/mastermind-session-truth/calibration/results.md).

add.title: 🐛 Fix the page error after reload
add.text: **Suggested task** (#114, "your agents broke my page"). After "page out of date, reload", the page threw a JavaScript error ("P is not a function"). The rule half (worktree, smoke test, merge only when ready) is already in agents.md. The error itself has no task.

add.title: 📄 Page storage and loading at scale
add.text:
**Suggested task** (#95). Converge pages on one storage system: embedded first, then a sub-page with its own folder past a threshold. Study how loading scales.

**Question:** when a parent page loads, does it load and replay every child page and delta?

**Suggested task:** a page index (`index.jsonl` with icon, title and preview) loaded one level deep. You said you had asked before, so past work should be searched first.

add.title: ⚙️ Page settings with a Files tab
add.text:
**Suggested task** (#116). Any page gets a settings screen. Its Files tab lists the page's folders and files and opens a file with syntax highlighting.

**Suggested task:** breadcrumbs exactly mirror `window.location.pathname`.

**Note, not a task:** you said not to build the toolbar and debug ideas yet.

add.title: 🧠 Plan first, and say who else is editing
add.text:
**Suggested task** (#116). A plan is the simplified class architecture. It is amended as decisions change, and then the build goes ahead without waiting for approval. (Close to the Plan idea in core/Task, written down but not built.)

**Suggested task:** the live-page docs warn that several agents may edit at once, so never assume the state is what you last saw.

**Question:** can the item tool read one property (`page.content`)? It can now: `item({path, read: "content"})`.

add.title: ✅ Already held by a task
add.text: #27 ("why we haven't been completing our sessions") is fully covered by close-with-proof and past-work-audit. Both models agreed.
